scripts.db:clean: docker exec thumbnailer-postgres psql -U thumbnailer -d thumbnailer -c 'TRUNCATE videos;'
scripts.clean: pnpm db:clean && pnpm output:clean && echo 'db + generated thumbnails cleaned'
scripts.topic:create: docker exec thumbnailer-redpanda rpk topic create video-jobs scan-commands scan-events thumbnail-ready db-flush -X brokers=localhost:9092 || true
scripts.services: pnpm --parallel --filter generator-service --filter scanner-service --filter sync-service --filter db-flush-service start
scripts.up: pnpm infra:up && pnpm db:setup && pnpm topic:create && pnpm services
scripts.dev: pnpm --parallel --filter generator-service --filter scanner-service --filter sync-service --filter db-flush-service dev
